title: Learning to Adapt Domain Shifts of Moral Values via Instance Weighting
reasoning: The paper is centered on the classification and measurement of moral values using the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT). It evaluates how language models (RNNs and BERT) represent and identify moral foundations such as authority, care, fairness, loyalty, and purity across various social movements, including a case study on COVID-19 vaccine-related moral values.
